meta.name: HAXcms
meta.about: The parts of HAXcms a site owner works in: the editor, Merlin, the outline designer, files, settings, the dashboard and the pieces that report back.

kindLabels.rel: which piece opens or feeds which

outline.desc: Bulk structure editing for a whole site: add, move, nest, rename and delete pages in one view, saved back to site.json in one operation.

files.desc: Upload and manage a site's images, documents and media from the HAXcms admin; files stay in the site's files/ folder.

settings.desc: Site-level settings: title, description, theme and theme options, authoring defaults, publishing and integrations, edited from the dashboard.

insights.desc: A planned admin dashboard of stats computed from site content: content, broken links, accessibility and where to add activities.

whatsnew.desc: A What's New dialog on the dashboard that tells people about new features, read by the CLI and agents too.

tips.desc: HAX Tips, including a tip of the day, surfaced in Merlin and sharing the What's New system.

tours.label: Around a HAXcms site
tours.message: The pieces of HAXcms a site owner touches, from writing a page to publishing the site.

scenes.caption: A HAXcms site is edited, managed and published from a few pieces.
Writing happens in the HAX editor, with Merlin for commands and the files area for media.
The outline designer restructures a whole site at once and saves it as JSON Outline Schema.
The dashboard holds settings, themes and publishing.
Insights, What's New and Tips close the loop back to people.
All of HAXcms, in one view.
